items.title: File objection (Einspruch) against the fine notice
items.quote: Einspruch gegen diesen Bußgeldbescheid können Sie innerhalb von zwei Wochen nach seiner Zustellung einlegen.
items.computation: Formal service (Zustellungsurkunde) is stated as 08.11.2025, so no deemed-delivery rule applies. The period starts the next day, 09.11.2025, and ends after two weeks on 22.11.2025. That is a Saturday, so under § 46 OWiG and § 43 StPO it moves to Monday 24.11.2025 (not a holiday in NW). The objection must reach the Bußgeldstelle by that day.

items.title: Pay fine and costs (EUR 128.50) within two weeks after the notice becomes final
items.quote: Sobald der Bescheid rechtskräftig ist, haben Sie für die Zahlung des Gesamtbetrags zwei Wochen Zeit; geben Sie als Verwendungszweck bitte das Aktenzeichen an.
items.computation: The payment period starts only when the notice becomes final (rechtskräftig). If no objection is filed, that happens when the objection period ends on 24.11.2025, so the two weeks would end around 08.12.2025. The exact finality date is not printed, so no fixed due date can be given. If you object, payment is not due until the matter is decided.

warnings: The payment deadline depends on when the notice becomes final, which the letter does not state. If no objection is filed, it is roughly 08.12.2025, but confirm this with the authority before relying on it.
The fine comes with 1 point in the Fahreignungsregister. Check the notice against the facts before deciding whether to object.
